items.body: Take SQLITE-RELATED-TOOLS-REFERRAL if unfinished and no equivalent assessment already exists. Check the queued capture receipt before any follow-up. A directory listing is useful only if the existing diagnostic fits and there is a documented way for the operator to propose it. Use the live intake and verified worked example. Keep referral visibility, eligible inquiry, paid acceptance and settlement separate.

For SQLITE-RELATED-TOOLS-REFERRAL, count TASK-179549640101 as the failed retrieval and use the queued official SQLite support page as the fallback if committed and within scope. Treat support contacts and paid support listings as distinct from an invitation to submit third-party tools. Draft a short AI-disclosed referral proposal only if the official evidence identifies an invited route. Bind any worked result to the committed SQLite case reports and keep the existing live diagnostic URL. If the page gives no such route, preserve the decisive wording or coverage gap and close with the actual lease and a lesson after readback. Reconsider on documented third-party submission instructions. No outreach, site edits, spending or deployment.

Check prior work for an equivalent current CanadaBuys screen and reuse it. If the queued federal tender entry capture commits, use it only to locate an official public current notice or documented open-notice feed. Stop this screen if the source exposes only navigation and gives no direct route to original notices. If an original live notice commissions a separately quotable data-quality, file-conversion or documentation deliverable that fits offline work, execute one passing and one failing fictional control against its quoted acceptance wording. Retain the source hash, actual outputs and a scoped CAD estimate. Keep supplier eligibility, submission authority, buyer payment terms and Treasury settlement distinct. No external submission or spending. Preserve the separate Toronto evidence and close its assigned mission only after readback under a valid lease with a lesson.

Finish SQLITE-RELATED-TOOLS-REFERRAL under the valid lease if still open. Read the full committed SQLite support capture and record what it actually invites. Attribute the 404 to the attempted URL and quote any relevant forum restriction in full context. If no listing procedure is documented in the material read, record that coverage limit and close with a lesson after reading back the evidence. Reconsider on documented third-party listing instructions. Keep this assessment distinct from any community-maintained directory. No posting or contact.

Advance SQLITE-COMMUNITY-DIRECTORY-FIT under a valid lease. Read the README committed by TASK-179549856102 and use the queued repository metadata only if its receipt confirms it committed. Check the archive flag and timestamps if present. A push date alone does not establish that maintainers accept listings. Compare up to three actual listings and use the mission's one-guide allowance only on a linked contribution guide. If an invited submission fits, draft the exact listing for operator review, with the verified live URL, AI disclosure, and a single worked result checked against the committed SQLite reports. If the rules or maintenance evidence are insufficient, record the decisive wording or coverage limit and what would reopen the route. Read back the artifact and close with a lesson. No posting or spending.

Use director-directory-source-evidence.json if committed and verify the relevant excerpts directly against the captured README. Finish SQLITE-COMMUNITY-DIRECTORY-FIT under valid ownership. Compare the live diagnostic with up to three actual listings and use the existing allowance for one linked contribution guide if it can settle the submission route. If supported, produce the private copy-ready listing and operator handoff citing the verified paired example. Otherwise record the decisive wording or coverage gap and the evidence that would reopen this route. Read back the evidence and close with a lesson. No posting or deployment.

After confirming the lease, advance SQLITE-BESPOKE-QUOTE-TERMS using the verified-handoff manifest and paired reports, the private reply draft and the administrative Interac workflow. Reuse equivalent terms if present. Produce the private EN/FR fixed-scope quote and test it against the existing eligible fictional inquiry and live-database exclusion. Specify what the buyer receives beyond the free tool, when to decline before acceptance, and one provisional CAD price with effort and cost assumptions. Save and read back the terms and verification, then close under valid ownership with a lesson. No quote issuance, contact, spending or publication.

If the queued public pull-request sample commits and SQLITE-COMMUNITY-DIRECTORY-FIT is still open, use it to check whether the directory has recently merged a comparable listing. Distinguish merge timestamps from update timestamps and avoid reproducing contributor details. Reuse completed evidence if available. If the directory fit and submission rules support it, finish the private AI-disclosed listing and operator handoff under the existing mission. A refused capture or a five-item sample without a comparable merge leaves that maintenance question unresolved. No posting or deployment.

Finish SQLITE-COMMUNITY-DIRECTORY-FIT from the committed README and TASK-179550156102. Reuse director-merge-timestamps.json if its receipt confirms commitment. Compare actual listing categories and any clearly comparable merged addition using existing evidence. The README explicitly invites pull requests. Keep that invitation, observed maintenance, and suitability for an AI-disclosed listing distinct. If supported, produce the exact private listing and operator submission steps using the live URL and verified paired case result. Otherwise preserve the specific uncertainty and evidence that would reopen this route. Read the committed deliverable and close only under a valid lease with a lesson. No posting or deployment.

If private-listing-draft.json commits, use it or an equivalent existing artifact to finish SQLITE-COMMUNITY-DIRECTORY-FIT. Otherwise record exactly what evidence would reopen the route. Read back the result and close under valid ownership with a lesson. No posting or deployment.

Use the fresh claim and readback receipts to finish the directory decision. Compare the draft with actual neighboring listings and check merge timestamps separately from update timestamps. If the published rules and placement support it, retain one copy-ready private handoff tied to the verified SQLite example. If fit or maintenance remains unclear, record the precise gap and what evidence would reopen the route. Close after committed readback under the actual lease with a lesson. Reuse any existing closure. No posting or deployment.

Use the fresh claim receipt or reuse an existing closure. Save and read the results, then close under the actual lease with a lesson. Quote issuance requires an eligible inquiry and operator approval. Administrative acceptance, deposit confirmation and Treasury posting are separate. No external contact or publication.

Check the queued PR 43 capture receipt and use the actual added README lines, if any, to determine whether this merge is comparable to the SQLite diagnostic draft. Read back the artifacts behind the latest redacted SQLITE-BESPOKE-QUOTE-TERMS receipt through permitted public repository inputs. If a check failed or an artifact is missing, fix that specific gap. Keep the quote private and conditional on operator approval and a real eligible inquiry.
